profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, traded under the ticker AUR and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001828108. Its website describes it as a self-driving technology company focused on autonomous freight, with the Aurora Driver as its core product. The company says the Aurora Driver combines hardware and software backed by what it calls verifiable AI, and that it is designed to integrate autonomy into customer fleets.

The site presents autonomous trucking as a safety and efficiency improvement for the freight industry. It quotes partners and customers describing pilot programs, including autonomous hauling between Fort Worth and El Paso and a hybrid model pairing professional drivers with the Aurora Driver. One quoted comment states that freight volumes are projected to grow five fold between 2010-2050, and another says the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous. The company describes its approach as transparent and safety-focused.

Beyond the company's own material, the record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Pennsylvania is listed as a jurisdiction with 180 law exposure entries.
